description.value: Apple Fifth Avenue is the Apple Store under the glass cube on Fifth Avenue at 59th Street. Apple posts Apple Store Fifth Avenue store hours, contact information, and weekly calendar of events online. It is a quick stop on a walk along Fifth Avenue and Central Park South.
